the development of new polymyxins that are better tolerated than the currently used polymyxin B or colistin (E).
the development of new polymyxin‐based antibiotics with improved properties.
the development of improved polymyxins with better tolerance.

the positive charge in the linear part is not necessary for antibacterial activity, and that the positive charges are better distributed between the cyclic part and the acyl tail.
